Application Data.NAME: Tech Haven Electronics
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Tech Haven Electronics is a retail business specializing in the sale and repair of consumer electronics, including smartphones, laptops, and tablets. The business generates 80% of its revenue from online sales, which increases its exposure to cyber risks. Our inventory includes repackaged and private-label electronics, presenting additional product liability and reputational risks. We have experienced some theft and inventory loss due to the high-value nature of our products. As a relatively new startup, we do not currently have a monitored security system in place, which raises concerns regarding safety practices and overall risk management.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Theft of high-value inventory occurred on 04/10/2023, resulting in a loss of $10,000. The incident is currently under investigation and has been reported to local authorities. Additionally, on 06/15/2023, we experienced a cyber incident leading to a temporary loss of access to our online sales platform, costing us approximately $5,000 in lost revenue. This issue was resolved quickly, but it highlighted the vulnerabilities associated with our predominantly online sales model.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored alarm system with 24/7 surveillance and security patrols.

Underwriting Guidelines:
– Revenue composition with 75% or more from online sales, which significantly increases
cyber risk and complicates physical inventory valuation.
– Sales of repackaged, counterfeit, or private-label electronics, which carry heightened prod-
uct liability and reputational risks.
– Locations with a history of frequent claims, poor safety practices, or unresolved under-
writing concerns.
Example: A well-established electronics retailer operating for 5 years at the same location, with
a monitored alarm system, 60% in-store sales and 40% online, and minimal slip-and-fall claims
would be a preferred risk. Conversely, a startup with 80% online sales and no alarm system would
be declined.
